verdict.rationale: Vestd has a dedicated HRIS integration page claiming to 'connect your HR platform to Vestd and end the manual data shuffle,' indicating some sync capability exists, but there's no detail on which HRIS systems (Gusto, Rippling, etc.) are supported, what data syncs (new hires/terminations specifically), or how automated equity record updates are. Missing for 10: named integration partners, specifics on new-hire/termination triggers flowing into equity records, technical/API documentation, and independent or hands-on confirmation the sync works as described.
